finding.description: method_spec.json contains three top-level fields not declared in the MethodSpec Pydantic schema: 'methodology_replication_contract', 'methodology_contract_pack', and 'replication_feasibility'. The schema uses extra='forbid' (via _Strict base class), so these extra keys cause schema validation to reject the entire spec.
finding.proposed_fix: Remove the three extra top-level keys (methodology_replication_contract, methodology_contract_pack, replication_feasibility) from method_spec.json. Keep all other fields intact. The MethodSpec schema (schemas/method_spec.py) only permits: schema_version, paper, core_method, paper_claims, try_it_out, data_requirements, dependencies, repo, comparison, critical_requirements, feasibility.

rationale: The validator error explicitly names the three forbidden keys as 'Extra inputs are not permitted [extra_forbidden]'. The MethodSpec class in schemas/method_spec.py inherits from _Strict (extra='forbid'), so these keys are genuinely not part of the schema. The analyzer invented these blocks, likely hallucinating from an older schema version or an internal template. Removing them is a surgical fix that doesn't affect any other part of the spec.

finding.description: select_batch maps core-set indices from x_pool space into x_unlabeled without offset adjustment. x_pool = cat([x_labeled, x_unlabeled]) at line 380 combines labeled (0..L-1) and unlabeled (L..L+U-1). Core-set indices from construct_ellipsoid_core_set reference the combined x_pool. Lines 391-392 filter 'idx >= len(x_labeled)' but then use the raw x_pool index to slice x_unlabeled — e.g., index 461 on an x_unlabeled of size 400. The indices need -len(x_labeled) offset to map into x_unlabeled space.
finding.proposed_fix: At lines 390-392 change to: `new_labeled_indices = [idx - labeled_len for idx in core_set_indices if idx >= labeled_len]` where `labeled_len = len(x_labeled)` is captured before the torch.cat. This offsets x_pool-space indices into x_unlabeled-space. Then update lines 398-400 to use the same offset-aware `new_labeled_indices` (already correct once new_labeled_indices is fixed).

rationale: No oscillation: prior iterations fixed (1) a NameError in notebook setup, (2) a missing torch.nn import in training.py, (3) a keepdim=True shape bug in compute_geometric_prior — each landed and exposed the next layer. This is a new bug: index-space mapping error in select_batch, owned by r2c-method-coder. The root cause is concrete, local to method/method.py, and the fix is a single arithmetic adjustment.
